messages:
ops_jordan: pagerbot stopped paging for CRITICAL sev1s in prod ~20m ago (around 10:03). Alerts in Datadog converted to incidents but nobody got pages. I manually escalated once. :rotating_light:
oncall_maria: yep seeing the same, got alerts in the console but no SMS/phone push. oncall rota didn't get notified. I'm oncall until 11:00, ping me if you need manual handoffs.
alex_kim: checking the bridge logs now — quick grep shows a flood of backfill events from the archive-sync job at 10:02 that spiked the suppressor counter. attaching snippet:
```
2026-03-17T10:02:12Z INFO archive-sync: replayed 1200 events to notify-bus
2026-03-17T10:02:13Z WARN pagerbridge:suppressor threshold reached for route=prod-pager, window_ms=60000
2026-03-17T10:02:13Z ERROR pagerbridge:drop page id=abc123 cause=suppressor_active
```
pagerbridge_bot: detected suppression window, incoming pages will be queued until suppressor cool-down. (suppression_id=sb-20260317-100213)
sre_lead_liz: thanks Alex. hypothesis: archive-sync replayed old alerts and triggered the suppressor which then blocked real pages. if suppressor uses monotonic counters without TTL, a big backfill can keep it latched.
ops_jordan: can we force clear the suppressor state now? I just tried the admin endpoint and it returned 502.
alex_kim: admin UI is flaky — trying `kubectl exec -it pagerbridge-ptl -- /bin/pagerbridgectl clear-suppress --id sb-20260317-100213`
alex_kim: ok ran the clear-suppress command, bridge returned 200 but pages still not flowing. tailing logs...
alex_kim: found unhealthy connection to notify-proxy (too many open sockets). restarting the pagerbridge pod to reset downstream connections: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/pagerbridge-prod`
sre_lead_liz: good, do a single-pod restart (no full rollout) and keep autoscaling off for now. ops, notify downstream on-call for notify-proxy.
ops_jordan: restarted pagerbridge pod (pagerbridge-prod-5f7d). watching metrics.
oncall_maria: got a manual SMS now — the manual escalation worked. :thumbsup:
pagerbot: manual escalation created: INC-20260317-8745, routed to oncall_maria via SMS (override).
alex_kim: pagerbridge logs show pages flowing again, suppressor state cleared, open sockets back to normal.
sre_lead_liz: mitigation confirmed. root cause preliminary: archive-sync backfill + suppressor latching + downstream notify-proxy connection exhaustion. impact: pages for sev1 were delayed ~20m for ~3 teams. no known customer outage beyond delayed pages.
ops_jordan: creating follow-up ticket with remediation plan (fix suppressor TTL, rate-limit archive-sync replays, improve admin clear endpoint). I'll tag infra and eng-runtime.
oncall_maria: live note: remind rotations to use manual override if you don't get paged within 5m of an incident firing.
sre_lead_liz: we'll run a small post-incident: 1) hotfix to make clear-suppress idempotent and return helpful errors, 2) add guardrails to archive-sync so it never triggers suppress threshold, 3) better alerting on suppressor flips (pagerbridge emits a metric but it's not hooked to paging).
ops_jordan: incident marked mitigated at 10:47. filing postmortem and tagging CS to coordinate any customer comms if needed. thanks all for quick coord. :tada:
